title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers and a target value, return the indices of the two numbers such that they add up to the target. Assume exactly one valid answer exists, and you may not use the same element twice.
input_format:
First line: space-separated integers (the array).
Second line: the target integer.
output_format: Two space-separated indices (0-based), in increasing order.
constraints:
2 <= array length <= 10^4
-10^9 <= array[i] <= 10^9
Exactly one valid answer exists.

starter_code.python:
# Read the array and target from stdin, print the two indices
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split('\n')
nums = list(map(int, data[0].split()))
target = int(data[1])
